short_bio: South African comedian who hosted The Daily Show from 2015 to 2022 and wrote the memoir Born a Crime.
biography:
Trevor Noah was born in Johannesburg in 1984 to a Black Xhosa mother and a white Swiss father, at a time when their relationship was illegal under apartheid. He built a stand-up career in South Africa and hosted television shows there.

In 2015 he succeeded Jon Stewart as host of The Daily Show on Comedy Central, and he stayed until December 2022. His memoir Born a Crime appeared in 2016.

He has hosted the Grammy Awards ceremony several times.
